metadata.assignment_note: 23 numerical-artifact tasks are assigned to AAJ with the read-only GIS verification agent, including five with existing qualitative rubrics. Other new component mappings remain proposed. Assignment status does not indicate evaluation completion.
metadata.rubric_note: Expanded rubric file preserves the original 83 entries and adds 13 manually authored task-specific rubrics in the same schema; no model generation or evaluation calls were made.
metadata.deterministic_check_note: Download-contract check placeholders are defined for 27 tasks; their presence is not successful evaluation. Source-dependent parameters require evidence resolution before deterministic checks.
metadata.numerical_placeholder_note: Three additional aggregation tasks and three clipped-extent tasks have numerical-scoring placeholders. Missing ground truth is not a zero score or completed evaluation.

deterministic_checks.expected: artifact identity agrees with recorded acquisition/request
deterministic_checks.notes: A filename alone does not prove product identity. Preserve candidate/run ownership; separate infrastructure failures from agent errors.
Check actual acquisition/time coordinates; specify calendar, timezone and interval coverage. Do not copy illustrative reference years. Seasonal/recent constraints need an accepted definition.

Define an accepted boundary/bbox and coverage tolerance before execution. Named regions do not imply one exact reference bbox; distinguish raw full-disk/global input from the required cropped/derived output.
Verify sampling/statistic and product metadata; time spacing alone does not prove mean/maximum/sum processing.
